evidence.title: GitHub - neka-nat/freecad-mcp: FreeCAD MCP(Model Context Protocol) server

name: FreeCAD MCP
summary: MCP server and FreeCAD addon that let Claude Desktop and other MCP clients create and edit 3D models.
description: FreeCAD MCP controls FreeCAD from Claude Desktop and other MCP clients: an addon inside FreeCAD exposes an RPC server and an MCP server in the client talks to it over localhost. It creates and edits models, runs Python scripts (GUI, background or headless), inspects documents and runs FEM analyses. Requires FreeCAD and uv/uvx.
contains: Two components: a FreeCAD addon (RPC server) and an MCP server launched by the client
Create and edit models, run Python scripts, inspect documents, run FEM analyses
Connects over localhost by default; claude_desktop_config.json setup in the README
Docs for installation, configuration, tools and code execution
